A Playwright scraper for the OC procurement portal that:\n   - Uses a headful browser (to bypass Cloudflare)\n   - Navigates to the procurement page\n   - Waits for the data to load\n   - Extracts all project data across all pages\n   - Saves to JSON\n\n2. A BigQuery loader script to push the data to `ppp_rico.oc_procurement`\n\n3. The unified badass map HTML\n\nLet me write all three. First, let me write the scraper.\n\nFor the procurement portal, since I can't see the actual HTML structure, I'll write a flexible scraper that:\n- Takes screenshots at each step for debugging\n- Tries multiple selectors to find project data\n- Extracts text from whatever structure it finds\n- Paginates through all pages\n\nLet me write it now.",time:$R[2478]={start:1782876498825,end:1782876501685},id:"prt_f1bb86b89001ng02Yurdhak1bs",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb85dde001N2wl2hYpxEiq8B"},$R[2479]={type:"tool",tool:"write",callID:"call_00_ezCj7cogCTAldzcxq4Co4512",state:$R[2480]={status:"completed",input:$R[2481]={filePath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement.py",content:"\"\"\"\nscrape_oc_procurement.py — Scrape Orange County OpenGov procurement portal\nAll projects across all pages -> JSON + CSV -> BigQuery\n\"\"\"\nimport asyncio, json, csv, re, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom playwright.async_api import async_playwright\n\nWORK_DIR = Path(\"C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work\")\nOUT_JSON = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_projects.json\"\nOUT_CSV = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_projects.csv\"\nSCREENSHOTS = WORK_DIR / \"procurement_screenshots\"\nSCREENSHOTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)\n\nBASE_URL = \"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov\"\n\ndef fmt(v):\n    return str(v).strip() if v else \"\"\n\nasync def extract_page_data(page, page_num):\n    print(f\"\\n--- PAGE {page_num} ---\")\n    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)\n    \n    projects = []\n    \n    # Try to find project cards/rows — OpenGov uses various layouts\n    # Strategy: look for structured data via multiple approaches\n    \n    # 1. Try card-based layout\n    cards = await page.query_selector_all('[class*=\"card\"], [class*=\"project\"], [class*=\"listing\"], [class*=\"result\"], [class*=\"row\"]')\n    print(f\"  Found {len(cards)} potential containers\")\n    \n    # 2. Try table rows\n    table_rows = await page.query_selector_all(\"table tbody tr, table tr[data-*]\")\n    print(f\"  Found {len(table_rows)} table rows\")\n    \n    # 3. Get all text links that look like project titles\n    links = await page.query_selector_all(\"a\")\n    project_links = []\n    for link in links:\n        href = await link.get_attribute(\"href\") or \"\"\n        text = (await link.inner_text()).strip()\n        if text and len(text) > 5 and (\"project\" in href.lower() or \"bid\" in href.lower() or \"rfp\" in href.lower() or \"solicitation\" in href.lower() or \"portal/ocgov\" in href.lower()):\n            project_links.append({\"text\": text, \"href\": href})\n    print(f\"  Found {len(project_links)} project-looking links\")\n    \n    # 4. Structured extraction — try to find repeating patterns\n    # Check for data attributes or React/Vue component structure\n    all_text = await page.inner_text(\"body\")\n    \n    # 5. Try API interception approach — look for XHR/fetch responses\n    # Most OpenGov portals use a REST API\n    try:\n        api_responses = await page.evaluate(\"\"\"() => {\n            const entries = performance.getEntriesByType('resource');\n            return entries.filter(e => e.name.includes('api') || e.name.includes('graphql') || e.name.includes('search') || e.name.includes('portal')).map(e => e.name);\n        }\"\"\")\n        if api_responses:\n            print(f\"  API endpoints found: {api_responses[:10]}\")\n    except:\n        pass\n    \n    # 6. Look for JSON-LD or embedded data\n    try:\n        scripts = await page.query_selector_all('script[type=\"application/json\"], script[type=\"application/ld+json\"], script[data-*]')\n        for s in scripts:\n            content = await s.inner_text()\n            if 'project' in content.lower() or 'solicitation' in content.lower():\n                print(f\"  Found embedded JSON with project data ({len(content)} chars)\")\n    except:\n        pass\n    \n    # 7. Dump visible text structure to understand page layout\n    text_lines = [l.strip() for l in all_text.split('\\n') if l.strip()]\n    print(f\"  Page text lines: {len(text_lines)}\")\n    print(f\"  First 20 lines:\")\n    for line in text_lines[:20]:\n        print(f\"    {line[:120]}\")\n    \n    # 8. If we found project links, collect details\n    if project_links:\n        for pl in project_links:\n            projects.append({\n                \"title\": pl[\"text\"],\n                \"url\": pl[\"href\"],\n                \"department\": \"\",\n                \"status\": \"\",\n                \"category\": \"\",\n                \"deadline\": \"\",\n                \"published\": \"\",\n                \"description\": \"\",\n                \"page\": page_num,\n                \"scraped_at\": datetime.now().isoformat()\n            })\n    \n    return projects, text_lines\n\n\nasync def main():\n    all_projects = []\n    all_text = []\n    \n    async with async_playwright() as p:\n        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=False)  # headful to bypass Cloudflare\n        context = await browser.new_context(\n            user_agent=\"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36\",\n            locale=\"en-US\",\n            viewport={\"width\": 1920, \"height\": 1080}\n        )\n        page = await context.new_page()\n        \n        print(f\"Navigating to {BASE_URL}...\")\n        await page.goto(BASE_URL, wait_until=\"networkidle\", timeout=60000)\n        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)\n        \n        # Take initial screenshot\n        await page.screenshot(path=str(SCREENSHOTS / \"page_1_initial.png\"), full_page=False)\n        print(\"Screenshot saved: page_1_initial.png\")\n        \n        # Check for Cloudflare\n        content = await page.content()\n        if \"Checking your browser\" in content or \"cf-browser-verification\" in content:\n            print(\"Cloudflare detected — waiting for challenge...\")\n            await page.wait_for_timeout(10000)\n            content = await page.content()\n        \n        # Dump page HTML for inspection (first 5000 chars)\n        print(\"\\n--- PAGE HTML (first 3000 chars) ---\")\n        print(content[:3000])\n        \n        # Try to find API calls by monitoring network\n        api_urls = []\n        def on_response(response):\n            url = response.url\n            if any(k in url for k in ['api', 'graphql', 'search', 'project', 'solicitation']) and response.status == 200:\n                try:\n                    ct = response.headers.get('content-type', '')\n                    if 'json' in ct:\n                        api_urls.append(url)\n                        print(f\"  API JSON response: {url}\")\n                except:\n                    pass\n        \n        page.on(\"response\", on_response)\n        \n        # Wait more for React to hydrate\n        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)\n        \n        # Try scrolling to trigger lazy loads\n        await page.evaluate(\"window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)\")\n        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)\n        await page.evaluate(\"window.scrollTo(0, 0)\")\n        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)\n        \n        # Extract page 1\n        projects, text_lines = await extract_page_data(page, 1)\n        all_projects.extend(projects)\n        all_text.extend(text_lines)\n        \n        # Try pagination — look for next page button\n        page_num = 1\n        while page_num \x3C 50:  # safety limit\n            next_btn = await page.query_selector_all('a[rel=\"next\"], button:has-text(\"Next\"), [aria-label=\"Next\"], [class*=\"pagination\"] button:last-child, a:has-text(\"Next\")')\n            if not next_btn:\n                # Try numeric pagination\n                page_num += 1\n                next_btn = await page.query_selector_all(f'a:has-text(\"{page_num}\"), button:has-text(\"{page_num}\")')\n            \n            if not next_btn:\n                print(f\"No more pagination found. Stopping at page {page_num-1}\")\n                break\n            \n            try:\n                await next_btn[0].click()\n                await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)\n                projects, text_lines = await extract_page_data(page, page_num)\n                all_projects.extend(projects)\n                all_text.extend(text_lines)\n                \n                await page.screenshot(path=str(SCREENSHOTS / f\"page_{page_num}.png\"), full_page=False)\n                \n                if not projects:\n                    print(f\"  No projects found on page {page_num}, may be end\")\n                    # Try once more\n                    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)\n                    projects2, _ = await extract_page_data(page, page_num)\n                    if not projects2:\n                        break\n                    all_projects.extend(projects2)\n                    \n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Pagination error at page {page_num}: {e}\")\n                break\n        \n        # Final screenshot\n        await page.screenshot(path=str(SCREENSHOTS / \"final.png\"), full_page=True)\n        \n        await browser.close()\n    \n    # Save results\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"TOTAL PROJECTS EXTRACTED: {len(all_projects)}\")\n    \n    with open(OUT_JSON, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(all_projects, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n    print(f\"JSON saved: {OUT_JSON}\")\n    \n    if all_projects:\n        # CSV\n        fieldnames = [\"title\", \"url\", \"department\", \"status\", \"category\", \"deadline\", \"published\", \"description\", \"page\", \"scraped_at\"]\n        with open(OUT_CSV, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction=\"ignore\")\n            writer.writeheader()\n            writer.writerows(all_projects)\n        print(f\"CSV saved: {OUT_CSV}\")\n    \n    # Save raw text for debugging\n    raw_text = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_raw_text.txt\"\n    with open(raw_text, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        f.write(\"\\n\".join(all_text))\n    print(f\"Raw text saved: {raw_text}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    asyncio.run(main())\n"},output:"Wrote file successfully.",metadata:$R[2482]={diagnostics:$R[2483]={},filepath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement.py",exists:!1,truncated:!1},title:"opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement.py",time:$R[2484]={start:1782876525542,end:1782876525585}},id:"prt_f1bb876bb001yP2Z0QFb4IdD32",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb85dde001N2wl2hYpxEiq8B"},$R[2485]={reason:"tool-calls",snapshot:"da62d53e302ad849d790282e2136656e5a4ba1e9",type:"step-finish",tokens:$R[2486]={total:57761,input:2117,output:2330,reasoning:194,cache:$R[2487]={write:0,read:53120}},cost:0.01323734,id:"prt_f1bb8e1fb001tuAXdXXnZf6Qsq",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb85dde001N2wl2hYpxEiq8B"},$R[2488]={type:"patch",hash:"77db8013ceed76405b4ad8cc9fdc79e4130137bf",files:$R[2489]=["C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work/scrape_oc_procurement.py"],id:"prt_f1bb8e7f7001ogXDbYmUYuDfhh",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb85dde001N2wl2hYpxEiq8B"}],msg_f1bb8e80d001I29BD0LJmTLqaR:$R[2490]=[$R[2491]={snapshot:"da62d53e302ad849d790282e2136656e5a4ba1e9",type:"step-start",id:"prt_f1bb8f2a3001EFyWN99Rldn3vx",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb8e80d001I29BD0LJmTLqaR"},$R[2492]={type:"reasoning",text:"Now let me also write the BigQuery loader and the unified map HTML. But the scraper needs a real browser (headless=False) which might not work in this environment. The map can be built assuming the procurement data will exist at a known path.",time:$R[2493]={start:1782876536168,end:1782876540162},id:"prt_f1bb8fd67001qseOnhwgF1l6Ci",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb8e80d001I29BD0LJmTLqaR"},$R[2494]={type:"text",text:"Now I'll build all three pieces. Let me write the BQ loader and the unified map in parallel while the scraper runs.",time:$R[2495]={start:1782876540209,end:1782876555504},id:"prt_f1bb90d3100165NiP8aqzeN683",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb8e80d001I29BD0LJmTLqaR"},$R[2496]={type:"tool",tool:"write",callID:"call_00_TWAKiKHF75PCeNGlO6E11826",state:$R[2497]={status:"completed",input:$R[2498]={filePath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\load_procurement_to_bq.py",content:"\"\"\"\nload_procurement_to_bq.py — Load OC procurement projects into BigQuery\nAfter scrape_oc_procurement.py runs, this loads the JSON into ppp_rico.oc_procurement\nAlso runs geocoding on addresses found in project descriptions\n\"\"\"\nimport json, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom google.cloud import bigquery\n\nWORK_DIR = Path(\"C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work\")\nIN_JSON = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_projects.json\"\nPROJECT = \"noble-beanbag-497411-m4\"\nDATASET = \"ppp_rico\"\nTABLE = \"oc_procurement\"\n\nclient = bigquery.Client(project=PROJECT)\n\n# Create table schema\nschema = [\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"title\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"url\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"department\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"status\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"category\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"deadline\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"published\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"description\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"amount_est\", \"FLOAT64\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"vendor_name\", \"STRING\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"page\", \"INTEGER\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"scraped_at\", \"TIMESTAMP\"),\n    bigquery.SchemaField(\"loaded_at\", \"TIMESTAMP\"),\n]\n\ntable_ref = f\"{PROJECT}.{DATASET}.{TABLE}\"\n\n# Load JSON\nif not IN_JSON.exists():\n    print(f\"ERROR: {IN_JSON} not found. Run scrape_oc_procurement.py first.\")\n    sys.exit(1)\n\nwith open(IN_JSON, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    projects = json.load(f)\n\nprint(f\"Loaded {len(projects)} projects from {IN_JSON}\")\n\nif not projects:\n    print(\"No projects to load. Exiting.\")\n    sys.exit(0)\n\n# Enrich: extract dollar amounts and vendor names from descriptions\nimport re\n\nfor p in projects:\n    desc = p.get(\"description\", \"\") + \" \" + p.get(\"title\", \"\")\n    # Dollar amounts\n    amounts = re.findall(r'\\$[\\d,]+(?:\\.\\d+)?|\\d[\\d,]*\\s*(?:million|billion)', desc, re.IGNORECASE)\n    if amounts:\n        try:\n            raw = amounts[0].replace(\"$\", \"\").replace(\",\", \"\").strip()\n            if \"million\" in raw.lower():\n                p[\"amount_est\"] = float(raw.split()[0].replace(\"$\",\"\").replace(\",\",\"\")) * 1e6\n            elif \"billion\" in raw.lower():\n                p[\"amount_est\"] = float(raw.split()[0].replace(\"$\",\"\").replace(\",\",\"\")) * 1e9\n            else:\n                p[\"amount_est\"] = float(raw)\n        except:\n            p[\"amount_est\"] = None\n    else:\n        p[\"amount_est\"] = None\n    \n    # Vendor/contractor names (words after \"awarded to\", \"vendor:\", \"contractor:\", etc.)\n    vendor_match = re.search(r'(?:awarded to|vendor|contractor|awardee)[:\\s]+([A-Z][A-Za-z\\s&.,]+?)(?:\\.|,|$|\\n)', desc, re.IGNORECASE)\n    p[\"vendor_name\"] = vendor_match.group(1).strip() if vendor_match else None\n    \n    p[\"loaded_at\"] = datetime.now().isoformat()\n    # Ensure scraped_at is a string\n    if not p.get(\"scraped_at\"):\n        p[\"scraped_at\"] = datetime.now().isoformat()\n\n# Create temp NDJSON for BQ load\nndjson_path = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_load.ndjson\"\nwith open(ndjson_path, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    for p in projects:\n        row = {\n            \"title\": p.get(\"title\", \"\"),\n            \"url\": p.get(\"url\", \"\"),\n            \"department\": p.get(\"department\", \"\"),\n            \"status\": p.get(\"status\", \"\"),\n            \"category\": p.get(\"category\", \"\"),\n            \"deadline\": p.get(\"deadline\", \"\"),\n            \"published\": p.get(\"published\", \"\"),\n            \"description\": p.get(\"description\", \"\"),\n            \"amount_est\": p.get(\"amount_est\"),\n            \"vendor_name\": p.get(\"vendor_name\"),\n            \"page\": p.get(\"page\", 0),\n            \"scraped_at\": p.get(\"scraped_at\", datetime.now().isoformat()),\n            \"loaded_at\": p.get(\"loaded_at\", datetime.now().isoformat()),\n        }\n        f.write(json.dumps(row) + \"\\n\")\n\nprint(f\"NDJSON written: {ndjson_path}\")\n\n# Create or replace table and load\ntry:\n    # Drop if exists\n    client.delete_table(table_ref, not_found_ok=True)\n    print(f\"Dropped existing table {table_ref}\")\n    \n    # Create table\n    table = bigquery.Table(table_ref, schema=schema)\n    table = client.create_table(table)\n    print(f\"Created table {table_ref}\")\n    \n    # Load data\n    job_config = bigquery.LoadJobConfig(\n        source_format=bigquery.SourceFormat.NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON,\n        write_disposition=bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_TRUNCATE,\n        autodetect=False,\n        schema=schema,\n    )\n    \n    with open(ndjson_path, \"rb\") as source_file:\n        load_job = client.load_table_from_file(source_file, table_ref, job_config=job_config)\n    \n    load_job.result()\n    \n    dest_table = client.get_table(table_ref)\n    print(f\"Loaded {dest_table.num_rows} rows into {table_ref}\")\n    \n    # Preview\n    preview = client.query(f\"SELECT title, department, status, amount_est, vendor_name FROM `{table_ref}` LIMIT 10\").to_dataframe()\n    print(\"\\nPreview:\")\n    print(preview.to_string(max_colwidth=60))\n    \nexcept Exception as e:\n    print(f\"BigQuery error: {e}\")\n    import traceback\n    traceback.print_exc()\n"},output:"Wrote file successfully.",metadata:$R[2499]={diagnostics:$R[2500]={},filepath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\load_procurement_to_bq.py",exists:!1,truncated:!1},title:"opencode_work\\load_procurement_to_bq.py",time:$R[2501]={start:1782876554686,end:1782876554700}},id:"prt_f1bb90e40001IsJBxger7yTNg5",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bb8e80d001I29BD0LJmTLqaR"},$R[2502]={type:"tool",tool:"bash",callID:"call_01_wCMWVjKs0m9a0kmN4EBf6896",state:$R[2503]={status:"completed",input:$R[2504]={command:"Get-ChildItem The page uses ReactTable (rt-table, rt-thead, rt-tbody, rt-tr, rt-td) - a div-based table library.\n\nThe structure is:\n- `rt-table` - the table container\n- `rt-thead` - header\n  - `rt-tr` - header row\n    - `rt-th` - header cells (Project Title, Project ID, Status, Addenda, Release Date, Due Date)\n- `rt-tbody` - body\n  - `rt-tr-group` - row groups\n    - `rt-tr` - data rows\n      - `rt-td` - data cells\n\nEach project row has:\n1. `rt-td` with link: Project Title (e.g., \"2026 Supportive Housing Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA)\")\n2. `rt-td` with Project ID (e.g., \"012-2026 NOFA\")\n3. `rt-td` with Status (e.g., \"Open\") and color styling\n4. `rt-td` with Addenda count\n5. `rt-td` with Release Date\n6. `rt-td` with Due Date\n\nAnd there's an \"Export to CSV\" button! Find all data rows (rt-tr inside rt-tbody)\n        rows = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-tbody .rt-tr-group .rt-tr\")\n        \n        for row in rows:\n            try:\n                cells = row.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-td\")\n                if len(cells) >= 5:\n                    title_el = cells[0].find_element(By.TAG_NAME, \"a\") if cells[0].find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, \"a\") else cells[0]\n                    title = title_el.text.strip()\n                    \n                    project_id = cells[1].text.strip()\n                    status = cells[2].text.strip()\n                    addenda = cells[3].text.strip() if len(cells) > 3 else \"\"\n                    release_date = cells[4].text.strip() if len(cells) > 4 else \"\"\n                    due_date = cells[5].text.strip() if len(cells) > 5 else \"\"\n                    \n                    # Get the project link\n                    link_el = cells[0].find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, \"a\")\n                    url = link_el[0].get_attribute(\"href\") if link_el else \"\"\n                    \n                    if title:\n                        projects.append({\n                            \"title\": title,\n                            \"project_id\": project_id,\n                            \"status\": status,\n                            \"addenda\": addenda,\n                            \"release_date\": release_date,\n                            \"due_date\": due_date,\n                            \"url\": url,\n                            \"department\": \"\",\n                            \"category\": \"\",\n                            \"description\": \"\",\n                            \"page\": 0,  # filled later\n                            \"scraped_at\": datetime.now().isoformat()\n                        })\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"  Row parse error: {e}\")\n                continue\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Extract error: {e}\")\n    \n    return projects\n\n\ndef get_pagination_info(driver):\n    \"\"\"Get total page count and current page\"\"\"\n    try:\n        # Look for pagination controls\n        # ReactTable pagination typically shows \"Page X of Y\" or has page buttons\n        page_info = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".-pagination, .pagination-bottom, [class*='pagination']\")\n        for pi in page_info:\n            text = pi.text\n            # Try to find total count\n            match = re.search(r'(\\d+)\\s*-\\s*(\\d+)\\s*of\\s*(\\d+)', text)\n            if match:\n                return int(match.group(3))\n            \n            # Or look for page buttons\n            buttons = pi.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, \"button\")\n            if buttons:\n                # Get last numeric button\n                nums = []\n                for b in buttons:\n                    try:\n                        n = int(b.text.strip())\n                        nums.append(n)\n                    except ValueError:\n                        pass\n                if nums:\n                    return max(nums)  # This is the total number of pages\n        \n        # Fallback: count page buttons\n        all_buttons = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \"button\")\n        page_nums = []\n        for b in all_buttons:\n            try:\n                n = int(b.text.strip())\n                page_nums.append(n)\n            except:\n                pass\n        if page_nums:\n            return max(page_nums)\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Pagination error: {e}\")\n    \n    return 0\n\n\ndef click_next_page(driver, current_page):\n    \"\"\"Click the next page button\"\"\"\n    try:\n        # Try the 'Next' button\n        next_btns = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \n            \"button.-next, button.next, button:has-text('Next'), [aria-label='Next Page'], button.-btn:last-child\")\n        \n        for btn in next_btns:\n            try:\n                if btn.is_enabled() and btn.is_displayed():\n                    btn.click()\n                    return True\n            except:\n                continue\n        \n        # Try clicking a specific page number\n        next_num = current_page + 1\n        page_btns = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \"button\")\n        for btn in page_btns:\n            try:\n                if btn.text.strip() == str(next_num) and btn.is_enabled():\n                    btn.click()\n                    return True\n            except:\n                continue\n        \n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Next page error: {e}\")\n    \n    return False\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"Launching undetected Chrome...\")\n    driver = uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=149)\n    \n    all_projects = []\n    page = 1\n    max_pages = 100  # safety limit\n    \n    try:\n        while page \x3C= max_pages:\n            url = BASE_URL.format(page=page)\n            print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n            print(f\"PAGE {page}: {url[:100]}...\")\n            \n            if page == 1:\n                driver.get(url)\n            else:\n                driver.get(url)\n            \n            time.sleep(6)  # wait for React to render\n            \n            # Extract projects\n            projects = extract_projects_from_page(driver)\n            \n            if not projects:\n                print(\"  No projects found on this page - stopping\")\n                break\n            \n            # Set page number\n            for p in projects:\n                p[\"page\"] = page\n            \n            all_projects.extend(projects)\n            \n            print(f\"  Extracted {len(projects)} projects (total: {len(all_projects)})\")\n            for p in projects[:3]:\n                print(f\"    {p['project_id']} | {p['status']} | {p['title'][:60]} | Due: {p['due_date']}\")\n            \n            # Check if there are more pages\n            if page == 1:\n                total_pages = get_pagination_info(driver)\n                if total_pages > 0:\n                    max_pages = min(total_pages, max_pages)\n                    print(f\"  Total pages detected: {total_pages}\")\n            \n            # Check if there's a next page\n            if page \x3C max_pages:\n                has_next = click_next_page(driver, page)\n                if has_next:\n                    page += 1\n                    time.sleep(3)\n                else:\n                    print(\"  No next page button - stopping\")\n                    break\n            else:\n                break\n    \n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"\\nFATAL ERROR: {e}\")\n        import traceback\n        traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    finally:\n        driver.quit()\n    \n    # Save results\n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"TOTAL PROJECTS: {len(all_projects)}\")\n    \n    # Remove duplicates\n    seen = set()\n    unique = []\n    for p in all_projects:\n        key = p.get(\"project_id\", \"\") + p.get(\"title\", \"\")\n        if key not in seen:\n            seen.add(key)\n            unique.append(p)\n    print(f\"UNIQUE: {len(unique)} (removed {len(all_projects) - len(unique)} duplicates)\")\n    \n    # Save JSON\n    with open(OUT_JSON, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(unique, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n    print(f\"JSON saved: {OUT_JSON}\")\n    \n    # Save CSV\n    fieldnames = [\"title\", \"project_id\", \"status\", \"addenda\", \"release_date\", \"due_date\", \"url\", \"department\", \"category\", \"description\", \"page\", \"scraped_at\"]\n    with open(OUT_CSV, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction=\"ignore\")\n        writer.writeheader()\n        writer.writerows(unique)\n    print(f\"CSV saved: {OUT_CSV}\")\n    \n    # Print summary by status\n    statuses = {}\n    for p in unique:\n        s = p.get(\"status\", \"Unknown\")\n        statuses[s] = statuses.get(s, 0) + 1\n    print(\"\\nBy Status:\")\n    for s, c in sorted(statuses.items()):\n        print(f\"  {s}: {c}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"},output:"Wrote file successfully.",metadata:$R[3306]={diagnostics:$R[3307]={},filepath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement_v2.py",exists:!1,truncated:!1},title:"opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement_v2.py",time:$R[3308]={start:1782878770122,end:1782878770138}},id:"prt_f1bdacaad001NW1v1HcRiARmo4",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdaae7f001LkjvDXAnsNUwMm"},$R[3309]={reason:"tool-calls",snapshot:"ebdf0990ff6651cd305202b001042d913a5eee81",type:"step-finish",tokens:$R[3310]={total:114018,input:1193,output:2233,reasoning:384,cache:$R[3311]={write:0,read:110208}},cost:0.012780996,id:"prt_f1bdb1814001bdaBz8BOvGbpmu",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdaae7f001LkjvDXAnsNUwMm"},$R[3312]={type:"patch",hash:"4d9c2a9cae362f3e9542cccaffffa9cd48eb9308",files:$R[3313]=["C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work/scrape_oc_procurement_v2.py"],id:"prt_f1bdb1b28001QGmUVULaz9WgGm",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdaae7f001LkjvDXAnsNUwMm"}],msg_f1bdb1b3b001tQdd3voN2cNY77:$R[3314]=[$R[3315]={snapshot:"ebdf0990ff6651cd305202b001042d913a5eee81",type:"step-start",id:"prt_f1bdb24ac001GeZ5OC8xRCLxer",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdb1b3b001tQdd3voN2cNY77"},$R[3316]={type:"reasoning",text:"Now let me run this scraper. Fixing pagination to get them all.",time:$R[3363]={start:1782878862782,end:1782878882812},id:"prt_f1bdc7dbe001Waf896QQyNrv0N",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdc67e2001ypreypqDQuUXH6"},$R[3364]={type:"tool",tool:"write",callID:"call_00_S0LmS2lXWnNoezO604q25430",state:$R[3365]={status:"completed",input:$R[3366]={filePath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement_v3.py",content:"\"\"\"\nscrape_oc_procurement_v3.py — Full scraper with working pagination\n27 pages x 50 projects = ~1,350 total\n\"\"\"\nimport undetected_chromedriver as uc\nfrom selenium.webdriver.common.by import By\nfrom selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait\nfrom selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC\nfrom selenium.common.exceptions import TimeoutException, NoSuchElementException, StaleElementReferenceException\nimport time, json, csv, re\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\nWORK_DIR = Path(\"C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work\")\nOUT_JSON = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_projects.json\"\nOUT_CSV = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_projects.csv\"\n\noptions = uc.ChromeOptions()\noptions.add_argument(\"--no-sandbox\")\noptions.add_argument(\"--disable-dev-shm-usage\")\noptions.add_argument(\"--window-size=1920,1080\")\n\n\ndef extract_projects(driver, page_num):\n    \"\"\"Extract all projects from current ReactTable page\"\"\"\n    projects = []\n    try:\n        rows = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-tbody .rt-tr-group .rt-tr\")\n        for row in rows:\n            try:\n                cells = row.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-td\")\n                if len(cells) \x3C 3:\n                    continue\n                \n                # Title from anchor inside first cell\n                title = \"\"\n                url = \"\"\n                try:\n                    link = cells[0].find_element(By.TAG_NAME, \"a\")\n                    title = link.text.strip()\n                    url = link.get_attribute(\"href\") or \"\"\n                except:\n                    title = cells[0].text.strip()\n                \n                project_id = cells[1].text.strip() if len(cells) > 1 else \"\"\n                status = cells[2].text.strip().replace(\"\\n\", \" \").replace(\"  \", \" \") if len(cells) > 2 else \"\"\n                addenda = cells[3].text.strip() if len(cells) > 3 else \"\"\n                release_date = cells[4].text.strip() if len(cells) > 4 else \"\"\n                due_date = cells[5].text.strip() if len(cells) > 5 else \"\"\n                \n                if title:\n                    projects.append({\n                        \"title\": title,\n                        \"project_id\": project_id,\n                        \"status\": status,\n                        \"addenda\": addenda,\n                        \"release_date\": release_date,\n                        \"due_date\": due_date,\n                        \"url\": url,\n                        \"department\": status.split(\"\\n\")[0] if \"\\n\" in status else \"\",\n                        \"category\": \"\",\n                        \"description\": \"\",\n                        \"page\": page_num,\n                        \"scraped_at\": datetime.now().isoformat()\n                    })\n            except StaleElementReferenceException:\n                continue\n            except Exception as e:\n                continue\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Extract error: {e}\")\n    \n    return projects\n\n\ndef click_next_button(driver):\n    \"\"\"Click the Next page button in ReactTable pagination\"\"\"\n    try:\n        # Strategy 1: Find button containing exactly \"Next\"\n        buttons = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \n            \".rt-pagination button, .-pagination button, [class*='pagination'] button\")\n        for btn in buttons:\n            try:\n                if btn.is_enabled() and btn.is_displayed():\n                    text = btn.text.strip()\n                    if text == \"Next\":\n                        btn.click()\n                        return True\n            except StaleElementReferenceException:\n                continue\n        \n        # Strategy 2: Find by aria or title\n        for selector in ['button[aria-label=\"Next Page\"]', 'button[aria-label=\"Next\"]', \n                         'button[title=\"Next\"]', 'button.-next', 'button.next']:\n            try:\n                btns = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, selector)\n                for btn in btns:\n                    if btn.is_enabled() and btn.is_displayed():\n                        btn.click()\n                        return True\n            except:\n                continue\n        \n        # Strategy 3: Find the last button in pagination row\n        pagination_row = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \n            \".-pagination, .rt-pagination, [class*='pagination-bottom']\")\n        if pagination_row:\n            buttons = pagination_row[0].find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, \"button\")\n            if buttons:\n                # Next is usually the last enabled button\n                for btn in reversed(buttons):\n                    try:\n                        if btn.is_enabled() and btn.is_displayed():\n                            text = btn.text.strip()\n                            if text in (\"Next\", \">\", \"»\", \"Next Page\"):\n                                btn.click()\n                                return True\n                            # If it's the last button and it's enabled, it's probably Next\n                            if btn == buttons[-1] and text != \"Previous\":\n                                btn.click()\n                                return True\n                    except:\n                        continue\n        \n        # Strategy 4: Click the button that looks like last in pagination\n        # The ReactTable has a specific structure with Previous | 1 | 2 | 3 | ... | Next\n        all_page_buttons = driver.find_elements(By.XPATH, \n            \"//button[contains(@class, '-btn') or contains(@class, '-pageBtn') or contains(@class, 'page')]\")\n        if len(all_page_buttons) >= 2:\n            # The last enabled button is usually Next\n            enabled = [b for b in all_page_buttons if b.is_enabled()]\n            if enabled:\n                enabled[-1].click()\n                return True\n                \n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Pagination click error: {e}\")\n    \n    return False\n\n\ndef get_total_pages(driver):\n    \"\"\"Get total page count from pagination text\"\"\"\n    try:\n        pagination = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \n            \".-pagination, .rt-pagination, [class*='pagination-bottom']\")\n        for p in pagination:\n            text = p.text\n            # \"Page 1 of 27\"\n            match = re.search(r'Page\\s+\\d+\\s+of\\s+(\\d+)', text)\n            if match:\n                return int(match.group(1))\n            # \"Showing 1-50 of 1350\"\n            match = re.search(r'of\\s+(\\d+)', text)\n            if match:\n                total_items = int(match.group(1))\n                return (total_items + 49) // 50  # ceil division by 50\n    except:\n        pass\n    return 0\n\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"Launching undetected Chrome (v149)...\")\n    driver = uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=149)\n    \n    all_projects = []\n    total_pages = 0\n    \n    try:\n        # Load page 1\n        url = \"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov?departmentId=all&status=all&page=1&limit=50&sortField=proposalDeadline&sortDirection=DESC\"\n        print(f\"Loading: {url[:90]}...\")\n        driver.get(url)\n        time.sleep(8)\n        \n        # Detect total pages\n        total_pages = get_total_pages(driver)\n        print(f\"Total pages detected: {total_pages if total_pages else 'unknown'}\")\n        if not total_pages:\n            total_pages = 27  # fallback from source analysis\n        \n        for page in range(1, total_pages + 1):\n            # For page > 1, we click Next instead of reloading URL\n            if page > 1:\n                driver.get(f\"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov?departmentId=all&status=all&page={page}&limit=50&sortField=proposalDeadline&sortDirection=DESC\")\n                time.sleep(5)\n            \n            print(f\"\\n--- PAGE {page}/{total_pages} ---\")\n            \n            # Extract\n            projects = extract_projects(driver, page)\n            all_projects.extend(projects)\n            \n            print(f\"  Got {len(projects)} projects (running total: {len(all_projects)})\")\n            if projects:\n                p = projects[0]\n                print(f\"  First: [{p['project_id']}] {p['title'][:60]} | {p['status']} | Due: {p['due_date']}\")\n                if len(projects) > 1:\n                    p = projects[-1]\n                    print(f\"  Last:  [{p['project_id']}] {p['title'][:60]} | {p['status']} | Due: {p['due_date']}\")\n            \n            if not projects:\n                print(\"  Empty page - stopping\")\n                break\n            \n            # Brief pause between pages\n            if page \x3C total_pages:\n                time.sleep(2)\n    \n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"\\nERROR: {e}\")\n        import traceback\n        traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    finally:\n        driver.quit()\n    \n    # Deduplicate\n    seen = set()\n    unique = []\n    for p in all_projects:\n        key = (p.get(\"project_id\", \"\"), p.get(\"title\", \"\"))\n        if key not in seen:\n            seen.add(key)\n            unique.append(p)\n    \n    print(f\"\\n{'='*60}\")\n    print(f\"SCRAPED: {len(all_projects)} | UNIQUE: {len(unique)} | Removed {len(all_projects)-len(unique)} dupes\")\n    \n    # Save\n    with open(OUT_JSON, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        json.dump(unique, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n    print(f\"JSON: {OUT_JSON} ({len(unique)} projects)\")\n    \n    fieldnames = [\"title\", \"project_id\", \"status\", \"addenda\", \"release_date\", \"due_date\", \n                  \"url\", \"department\", \"category\", \"description\", \"page\", \"scraped_at\"]\n    with open(OUT_CSV, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction=\"ignore\")\n        writer.writeheader()\n        writer.writerows(unique)\n    print(f\"CSV: {OUT_CSV}\")\n    \n    # Stats\n    statuses = {}\n    for p in unique:\n        s = p.get(\"status\", \"Unknown\")\n        statuses[s] = statuses.get(s, 0) + 1\n    print(f\"\\nStatus breakdown:\")\n    for s, c in sorted(statuses.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):\n        print(f\"  {s}: {c}\")\n    \n    # Open projects specifically\n    open_count = sum(1 for p in unique if p.get(\"status\", \"\").startswith(\"Open\"))\n    print(f\"\\nOPEN: {open_count} | TOTAL: {len(unique)}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n"},output:"Wrote file successfully.",metadata:$R[3367]={diagnostics:$R[3368]={},filepath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement_v3.py",exists:!1,truncated:!1},title:"opencode_work\\scrape_oc_procurement_v3.py",time:$R[3369]={start:1782878882707,end:1782878882720}},id:"prt_f1bdc7f6b001eLTFqoBfvodewP",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdc67e2001ypreypqDQuUXH6"},$R[3370]={reason:"tool-calls",snapshot:"2ff70fc7675ef7b68545e956f74410c514e3601c",type:"step-finish",tokens:$R[3371]={total:119656,input:348,output:2526,reasoning:174,cache:$R[3372]={write:0,read:116608}},cost:0.011692336,id:"prt_f1bdcd010001TKpx87Dm9CAU8E",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdc67e2001ypreypqDQuUXH6"},$R[3373]={type:"patch",hash:"598b6e239380b93919c975925858f53b3d0d1bd6",files:$R[3374]=["C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work/scrape_oc_procurement_v3.py"],id:"prt_f1bdcd369001gqp83UUtW5VYnH",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdc67e2001ypreypqDQuUXH6"}],msg_f1bdcd386001U7Zm4AcWXmWWps:$R[3375]=[$R[3376]={snapshot:"2ff70fc7675ef7b68545e956f74410c514e3601c",type:"step-start",id:"prt_f1bdcdd56001xmoLuHsvlKBizh",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1bdcd386001U7Zm4AcWXmWWps"},$R[3377]={type:"reasoning",text:"Now let me run the v3 scraper. user is telling me they're logging me in. They want me to use their credentials to access the procurement portal. They're frustrated that the scraper isn't working.\n\nBut wait - I don't need to be logged in. The procurement portal is publicly accessible. The earlier successful test (`uc_test.py`) showed the public procurement list without any login. The issue is that the browser was loading a saved profile.\n\nLet me check - actually, looking at the problem more carefully: the scraper initially worked (50 projects extracted), but the pagination failed. Then I tried again and the browser loaded a login screen. This is because undetected-chromedriver uses a persistent profile directory and that profile now has a logged-in session from the user's own browser usage.\n\nThe fix is to use incognito/clean profile mode. Let me try again with the incognito fix.\n\nActually, let me re-read the user's message: \"imLOGGIN YOU IN ASSHOLW\" - they're frustrated and saying they'll log in for me. They think the issue is authentication.\n\nThe procurement portal at `procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov` is PUBLIC - you don't need to be logged in to see the project list. The login was only shown because the browser profile had a saved session.\n\nLet me run the scraper with the incognito fix now. Actually, the previous run had already been updated with `--incognito` and `--user-data-dir`. Let me run it again.\n\nBut first, let me also make the scraper more robust. The user is getting Wait for table\n    rows = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-tbody .rt-tr\")\n    print(f\"Rows loaded: {len(rows)}\")\n    \n    # Click first project link\n    first_cell = rows[0].find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-td a\")\n    project_name = first_cell.text.strip()\n    print(f\"Clicking: {project_name}\")\n    \n    # Get the href (even if it's #, we need the onclick)\n    href = first_cell.get_attribute(\"href\")\n    print(f\"href attr: {href}\")\n    \n    # Click it\n    first_cell.click()\n    time.sleep(8)\n    \n    # Look for download/attachment links\n    body_text = driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME, \"body\").text\n    print(f\"\\n--- BODY TEXT (first 1500 chars) ---\")\n    print(body_text[:1500])\n    \n    # Search for file links\n    all_links = driver.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, \"a\")\n    file_links = []\n    for l in all_links:\n        try:\n            h = l.get_attribute(\"href\") or \"\"\n            t = l.text.strip()\n            if any(ext in h.lower() for ext in ['.pdf','.doc','.docx','.xls','.xlsx','.csv','.zip','attachment','download','file','document']):\n                file_links.append((t, h))\n        except:\n            pass\n    \n    print(f\"\\n--- FILE/DOWNLOAD LINKS ({len(file_links)}) ---\")\n    for t, h in file_links[:20]:\n        print(f\"  {t[:60]} | {h[:100]}\")\n    \n    # Also find all links in DOM\n    all_links = driver.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME, \"a\")\n    print(f\"\\nAll DOM links: {len(all_links)}\")\n    file_links = []\n    for l in all_links:\n        try:\n            href = l.get_attribute(\"href\") or \"\"\n            text = l.text.strip()\n            if any(href.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in ['.pdf','.doc','.docx','.xls','.xlsx','.csv','.zip']):\n                file_links.append({\"text\": text, \"href\": href})\n                print(f\"  FILE: {text[:60]} | {href[:120]}\")\n        except:\n            pass\n    \n    if not file_links and not file_urls:\n        # uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=149)\n\nall_data = []\n\ntry:\n    for page in range(1, 28):\n        print(f\"Page {page}...\", end=\" \", flush=True)\n        \n        driver.get(f\"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov?departmentId=all&status=all&page={page}&limit=50&sortField=proposalDeadline&sortDirection=DESC\")\n        time.sleep(6)\n        \n        for _ in range(10):\n            rows = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-tbody .rt-tr\")\n            if rows: break\n            time.sleep(2)\n        \n        if not rows:\n            print(\"NO ROWS\")\n            continue\n        \n        # Extract data array from ReactTable component\n        data = driver.execute_script(\"\"\"\n            var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.rt-tbody .rt-tr');\n            if (!rows.length) return [];\n            \n            var row = rows[0];\n            for (var key in row) {\n                if (key.startsWith('__reactFiber')) {\n                    var fiber = row[key];\n                    var node = fiber;\n                    \n                    // Walk up to find the ReactTable component\n                    while (node) {\n                        if (node.memoizedProps && node.memoizedProps.data && Array.isArray(node.memoizedProps.data)) {\n                            return node.memoizedProps.data;\n                        }\n                        if (node.memoizedProps && node.memoizedProps.columns) {\n                            // This is the ReactTable - data might be in pendingProps or stateNode\n                            var p = node.memoizedProps;\n                            if (p.data && Array.isArray(p.data)) return p.data;\n                            // Check stateNode\n                            if (node.stateNode && node.stateNode.props && node.stateNode.props.data) {\n                                return node.stateNode.props.data;\n                            }\n                            // Check resolved data\n                            if (p.resolvedData && Array.isArray(p.resolvedData)) return p.resolvedData;\n                            if (p.sortedData && Array.isArray(p.sortedData)) return p.sortedData;\n                        }\n                        node = node.return;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            return [];\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        if data and len(data) > 0:\n            all_data.append({\"page\": page, \"projects\": data})\n            print(f\"[{len(data)} projects]\")\n        else:\n            print(\"NO DATA\")\n    \nfinally:\n    driver.quit()\n\n# Flatten all projects\nflat = []\nfor page_data in all_data:\n    for proj in page_data[\"projects\"]:\n        flat.append(proj)\n\nprint(f\"\\nTOTAL: {len(flat)} projects from {len(all_data)} pages\")\n\n# Save\nwith open(OUT, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    json.dump(flat, f, indent=2, default=str)\nprint(f\"Saved: {OUT}\")\n\n# Show sample\nif flat:\n    print(f\"\\nSample project keys: {list(flat[0].keys())}\")\n    print(json.dumps(flat[0], the React fiber dump and build a complete procurement index with full URLs\"\"\"\nimport json, csv, re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nWORK_DIR = Path(\"C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work\")\nIN_JSON = WORK_DIR / \"oc_projects_full_react.json\"\nOUT_CSV = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_index.csv\"\n\nif not IN_JSON.exists():\n    print(f\"Error: {IN_JSON} not found!\")\n    exit(1)\n\nwith open(IN_JSON, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    projects = json.load(f)\n\nprint(f\"Loaded {len(projects)} raw projects from React fiber dump\")\n\nparsed = []\nall_docs = []\n\nfor i, p in enumerate(projects):\n    # React fields\n    title = p.get(\"title\", \"\").strip()\n    financial_id = p.get(\"financialId\", \"\").strip()\n    status = p.get(\"closedSubstatus\", \"\") or \"\"\n    if not status:\n        # Check active status\n        status = \"Open\" if p.get(\"active\") else \"Closed\"\n    \n    release_date = p.get(\"releaseProjectDate\", \"\") or p.get(\"releaseDate\", \"\") or \"\"\n    due_date = p.get(\"proposalDeadline\", \"\") or p.get(\"dueDate\", \"\") or \"\"\n    \n    # Numeric ID is often 'id' or 'uuid' or 'projectId'\n    num_id = p.get(\"id\") or p.get(\"projectId\") or p.get(\"uuid\") or \"\"\n    \n    # Construction URL\n    project_url = f\"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/{num_id}\" if num_id else \"\"\n    \n    # Extract summary\n    summary_html = p.get(\"summary\", \"\") or \"\"\n    # strip HTML\n    summary = re.sub(r'\x3C[^>]+>', ' ', summary_html)\n    summary = re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', summary).strip()\n    \n    # Extract documents/addenda from the React state if present\n    docs = []\n    addendums = p.get(\"addendums\", []) or []\n    for add in addendums:\n        if isinstance(add, dict):\n            # check for files or titles\n            add_title = add.get(\"title\", \"\") or add.get(\"name\", \"\")\n            if add_title: docs.append(f\"Addendum: {add_title}\")\n    \n    # Check for other attachment fields\n    attachments = p.get(\"attachments\", []) or p.get(\"documents\", []) or []\n    for att in attachments:\n        if isinstance(att, dict):\n            att_title = att.get(\"title\", \"\") or att.get(\"name\", \"\") or att.get(\"filename\", \"\")\n            if att_title: docs.append(att_title)\n            \n    # Fallback: extract any links from the summary HTML that look like files\n    doc_links = re.findall(r'href=\"([^\"]*\\.(?:pdf|docx?|xlsx?|csv|zip)[^\"]*)\"', summary_html, re.I)\n    docs.extend(doc_links)\n    \n    # Remove duplicates\n    docs = list(set(docs))\n    \n    parsed.append({\n        \"numeric_id\": num_id,\n        \"project_id\": financial_id,\n        \"title\": title,\n        \"status\": status,\n        \"release_date\": release_date,\n        \"due_date\": due_date,\n        \"url\": project_url,\n        \"document_count\": len(docs),\n        \"documents\": \" | \".join(docs),\n        \"description\": summary[:300] + \"...\" if len(summary) > 300 else summary,\n        \"page\": p.get(\"page\", 0)\n    })\n    \n    # Create file-level index\n    if docs:\n        for doc in docs:\n            # Check if doc is a URL or name\n            if doc.startswith(\"http\"):\n                doc_url = doc\n                doc_name = doc.split(\"/\")[-1].split(\"?\")[0]\n            else:\n                doc_url = f\"{project_url}#tab-documents\"\n                doc_name = doc\n                \n            all_docs.append({\n                \"project_numeric_id\": num_id,\n                \"project_id\": financial_id,\n                \"project_title\": title,\n                \"document_name\": doc_name,\n                \"download_url\": doc_url\n            })\n    else:\n        # At least add a placeholder for the project folder\n        all_docs.append({\n            \"project_numeric_id\": num_id,\n            \"project_id\": financial_id,\n            \"project_title\": title,\n            \"document_name\": \"Project Folder (Open in Browser to download attachments)\",\n            \"download_url\": project_url\n        })\n\nprint(f\"Parsed {len(parsed)} projects\")\nprint(f\"Generated {len(all_docs)} file-level index rows\")\n\n# Save project index\nwith open(OUT_CSV, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    fieldnames = [\"numeric_id\", \"project_id\", \"title\", \"status\", \"release_date\", \"due_date\", \"url\", \"document_count\", \"documents\", \"description\"]\n    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction=\"ignore\")\n    writer.writeheader()\n    writer.writerows(parsed)\nprint(f\"Saved project index: {OUT_CSV}\")\n\n# Save file-level index\nOUT_FILES = WORK_DIR / \"oc_procurement_files_index.csv\"\nwith open(OUT_FILES, \"w\", newline=\"\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    fieldnames = [\"project_numeric_id\", \"project_id\", \"project_title\", \"document_name\", It will:\n- Load any existing progress\n- Process one page at a time\n- Save after each page\n- Use shorter waits\n- Skip pages already done\n\nThis should complete all 27 pages in a few minutes and be recoverable.",time:$R[4126]={start:1782889790605,end:1782889814180},id:"prt_f1c833c8d0013JBLxuifSVSAht",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1c8318d7001EYRIgy3IcnctvH"},$R[4127]={type:"tool",tool:"write",callID:"write_160",state:$R[4128]={status:"completed",input:$R[4129]={filePath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\rip_all_safe.py",content:"\"\"\"Robust rip all pages, save after each, resume if interrupted\"\"\"\nimport undetected_chromedriver as uc\nfrom selenium.webdriver.common.by import By\nimport time, json, tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nWORK_DIR = Path(\"C:/Users/HP/OneDrive/Documents/opencode_work\")\nOUT = WORK_DIR / \"oc_projects_full_react.json\"\n\ntmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()\noptions = uc.ChromeOptions()\noptions.add_argument(\"--no-sandbox\")\noptions.add_argument(\"--window-size=1920,1080\")\noptions.add_argument(f\"--user-data-dir={tmpdir}\")\n\nall_data = {}\nif OUT.exists():\n    try:\n        all_data = json.load(open(OUT, \"r\", encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n        if not isinstance(all_data, dict):\n            all_data = {}\n        print(f\"Resumed with {len(all_data)} pages already done\")\n    except:\n        all_data = {}\n\ndriver = uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=149)\n\ntry:\n    for page in range(1, 28):\n        if str(page) in all_data:\n            print(f\"Page {page} already done, skipping\")\n            continue\n        \n        print(f\"Page {page}/27...\", end=\" \", flush=True)\n        \n        try:\n            driver.get(f\"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov?departmentId=all&status=all&page={page}&limit=50&sortField=proposalDeadline&sortDirection=DESC\")\n            \n            # Wait up to 30s for rows\n            rows = []\n            for _ in range(15):\n                rows = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \".rt-tbody .rt-tr\")\n                if rows: break\n                time.sleep(2)\n            \n            if not rows:\n                print(\"NO ROWS\")\n                continue\n            \n            # Extract data from ReactTable\n            data = driver.execute_script(\"\"\"\n                var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.rt-tbody .rt-tr');\n                if (!rows.length) return [];\n                var row = rows[0];\n                for (var key in row) {\n                    if (key.startsWith('__reactFiber')) {\n                        var node = row[key];\n                        while (node) {\n                            if (node.memoizedProps && node.memoizedProps.data && Array.isArray(node.memoizedProps.data)) {\n                                return node.memoizedProps.data;\n                            }\n                            node = node.return;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                return [];\n            \"\"\")\n            \n            if data and len(data) > 0:\n                all_data[str(page)] = data\n                print(f\"[{len(data)} projects] SAVED\")\n                # Save progress\n                with open(OUT, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n                    json.dump(all_data, f, indent=2, default=str)\n            else:\n                print(\"NO DATA\")\n        \n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"ERROR: {e}\")\n            continue\n\nfinally:\n    driver.quit()\n\n# Flatten\nflat = []\nfor page_num in sorted(all_data.keys(), key=int):\n    flat.extend(all_data[page_num])\n\nwith open(OUT, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n    json.dump(flat, f, indent=2, default=str)\n\nprint(f\"\\nDONE: {len(flat)} projects from {len(all_data)} pages\")\n"},output:"Wrote file successfully.",metadata:$R[4130]={diagnostics:$R[4131]={},filepath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\rip_all_safe.py",exists:!1,truncated:!1},title:"..\\..\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\rip_all_safe.py",time:$R[4132]={start:1782889813204,end:1782889813251}},id:"prt_f1c8349ab001rjj0WOvmmBu4WE",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1c8318d7001EYRIgy3IcnctvH"},$R[4133]={type:"tool",tool:"bash",callID:"bash_161",state:$R[4134]={status:"completed",input:$R[4135]={command:"python C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\rip_all_safe.py",timeout:900000},output:"Page 1/27... if detail page Downloads tab has file URLs in React state\"\"\"\nimport undetected_chromedriver as uc\nfrom selenium.webdriver.common.by import By\nimport time, json, tempfile, re\n\ntmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()\noptions = uc.ChromeOptions()\noptions.add_argument(\"--no-sandbox\")\noptions.add_argument(\"--window-size=1920,1080\")\noptions.add_argument(f\"--user-data-dir={tmpdir}\")\n\ndriver = uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=149)\n\ntry:\n    driver.get(\"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/210644\")\n    time.sleep(8)\n    \n    # Click Downloads tab\n    dl = driver.find_element(By.XPATH, \"//a[contains(text(),'Downloads')]\")\n    dl.click()\n    time.sleep(3)\n    \n    # Dump window data\n    state = driver.execute_script(\"\"\"\n        function findFiles(obj, depth) {\n            if (depth > 10) return [];\n            var files = [];\n            if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return files;\n            \n            for (var key in obj) {\n                var val = obj[key];\n                if (val === null || val === undefined) continue;\n                \n                // Check if this looks like a file/attachment\n                if ((key === 'url' || key === 'downloadUrl' || key === 'fileUrl' || key === 'file_path' || key === 'path' || key === 's3Url') && typeof val === 'string' && val.length > 5) {\n                    files.push({key: key, url: val});\n                }\n                \n                if ((key === 'fileName' || key === 'filename' || key === 'name' || key === 'title') && typeof val === 'string' && val.length > 0) {\n                    files.push({key: key, name: val});\n                }\n                \n                if (typeof val === 'object') {\n                    var subFiles = findFiles(val, depth + 1);\n                    files = files.concat(subFiles);\n                }\n            }\n            return files;\n        }\n        \n        if (!window.__data) return 'no __data';\n        return JSON.stringify(findFiles(window.__data, 0));\n    \"\"\")\n    \n    print(f\"Files in state ({len(state)} chars):\")\n    print(state[:5000])\n    \n    # Also get all URLs in page source\n    src = driver.page_source\n    urls = re.findall(r'https?://[^\"\\'\\s]+', src)\n    file_urls = [u for u in urls if any(ext in u.lower() for ext in ['.pdf','.doc','.xls','.csv','.zip','amazonaws','opengov','download'])]\n    print(f\"\\nFile-ish URLs in source: {len(file_urls)}\")\n    for u in file_urls[:30]:\n        print(f\"  {u[:120]}\")\n\nfinally:\n    driver.quit()\n"},output:"Wrote file We're in plan mode now\n\nLet me organize this into the required structure.",time:$R[4380]={start:1782926129759,end:1782926130326},id:"prt_f1eadba5f001RfsKfl9Fc0hP5B",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f1ead8c37001BHw3Wifugy9Iee"},$R[4381]={type:"text",text:"## Goal\n- Build a complete OSINT command center map with all investigation data, and fully extract/scrape the Orange County OpenGov procurement portal including all project files/attachments with direct download URLs.\n\n## Constraints & Preferences\n- Single-file HTML map deployable to GitHub Pages; zero external JS deps beyond Leaflet CDN\n- OC procurement portal (procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov) is behind Cloudflare Turnstile — must use undetected-chromedriver to bypass\n- User's PC cannot store all attachment files — must index or upload to cloud\n- User wants complete file-level index with full download URLs spelled out per project\n- \"27 pages\" of procurement data, \"1,321 projects\" expected\n- User has been extremely frustrated by delays and failed extractions\n\n## Progress\n### Done\n- `index.html` — 30KB unified badass map: 50-state national pipeline data + OC detail layers (toxic, suspect LLCs, plume, sinkholes, black holes, financial veins, CPS events, FCA timeline, target entities, procurement placeholders). All data embedded inline. Layer toggles, search (Ctrl+F), threat mode (Ctrl+T). Ready for GitHub Pages deploy.\n- `pipeline_map_totals.json` — baked into map as fallback\n- 1,322 OC procurement projects scraped from all 27 listing pages via undetected-chromedriver React fiber introspection → `oc_projects_full_react.json`\n- Project index CSV generated → `oc_procurement_index.csv` with project_id, title, status, dates, full detail page URL (e.g. `https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/{numeric_id}`)\n- Detail page structure confirmed: URL pattern `/projects/{numeric_id}`, Downloads tab with checkboxes + \"Download Selected Items\" button, React state (`window.__data`) contains S3 download URLs (e.g. `government-project.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/210644/uuid_filename.pdf?X-Amz-Algorithm=...`)\n- `load_procurement_to_bq.py` — BigQuery loader script ready (runs after data exists)\n- `scrape_oc_procurement_v3.py` — initial functioning scraper (50 project/page, extracts title/project_id/status/dates)\n- `scrape_oc_procurement_v2.py`, `scrape_oc_procurement.py` — earlier scraper iterations (deprecated)\n\n### In Progress\n- File-level extraction: `extract_file_links.py` last run result unknown (returned no output; 0 files found in prior run because Downloads tab wasn't clicked before reading state; script was updated to click Downloads tab but hasn't been verified to correctly extract S3 URLs)\n\n### Blocked\n- **File/attachment download from procurement projects**: Extraction scripts ran but returned 0 file rows — root cause was the Downloads tab not being clicked before reading `window.__data`. Fixed in latest version of `extract_file_links.py` but the fix hasn't been confirmed working.\n- Signed S3 download URLs expire (~20 hours), so the index is time-sensitive if used for direct downloads\n- User is furious (calling the work \"trash\") after hours of delays and failed extraction runs\n\n## Key Decisions\n- Use undetected-chromedriver (v3.5.5) for Cloudflare Turnstile bypass — only method that worked\n- Extract project data from React fiber (``__reactFiber$...`` memoizedProps.data`) on listing pages — gets all 50 projects per page in one JS call, no clicking needed\n- Extract file download URLs from `window.__data` on detail pages after clicking Downloads tab — only exposes file data after tab activation\n- Save extraction progress every N projects to allow resume after interruption\n- Store numeric project IDs (e.g. 210644) and direct S3 paths (e.g. `210644/uuid_filename.pdf`) for persistent file reference\n\n## Next Steps\n1. Verify current state of `oc_procurement_files_full.json` — check if last extraction run produced any output\n2. If empty, rerun `extract_file_links.py` with Downloads-tab click fix — this processes all 1,322 detail pages (~60-90 min)\n3. Generate final `oc_procurement_files_index_full.csv` with: project ID, project title, project URL, file name, S3 path, signed download URL\n4. Run `load_procurement_to_bq.py` to push project metadata → `ppp_rico.oc_procurement`\n5. Write a second BigQuery load for file index → `ppp_rico.oc_procurement_files`\n6. Update `index.html` procurement layer to use full BigQuery dataset instead of placeholder markers\n7. Deploy `index.html` to GitHub Pages (push to osint-agent repo root, enable Pages in Settings)\n8. Optionally: download files from S3 and upload to cloud storage if user provides destination\n\n## Critical Context\n- OpenGov API is not publicly accessible; all data must be scraped via browser\n- S3 signed URLs expire after ~20 hours (`X-Amz-Expires=72000` seconds) — the extracted download links are temporary\n- S3 bucket: `government-project.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com` — persistent file path includes project numeric ID + UUID + filename\n- Some projects may have zero attachments (the first project 210644 had 2 files but the React listing state didn't include them)\n- Running too many undetected-chromedriver sessions creates zombie Chrome processes — must kill them between runs\n- User's email is txtdjdrop@gmail.com (appears in saved login state from a prior session)\n\n## Relevant Files\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\index.html`: Unified command center map (ready for deploy)\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\oc_projects_full_react.json`: Raw React fiber data dump of all 1,322 projects (27 pages)\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\oc_procurement_index.csv`: Project-level index with numeric IDs and full URLs\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\oc_procurement_projects.csv`: Initial scrape of 1,321 projects (title, project_id, status, dates)\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\oc_projects_api_data.json`: Empty — API capture approach failed\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\procurement_screenshots\\page_source.html`: Saved HTML from successful Cloudflare bypass test (443KB)\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\procurement_screenshots\\detail_downloads.html`: Detail page source with Downloads tab visible\n- `C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\extract_file_links.py`: File extraction script (latest version includes Downloads tab click fix; The URL for this page might be the main project page (`/projects/210644`) but with the Downloads tab activated.\n\nLooking at the HTML navigation:\n```html\n\x3Cli class=\"\" role=\"presentation\">\x3Ca data-qa=\"navbar-navItem-projectDocuments\" ...\n    href=\"/portal/ocgov/projects/210644/document\">Project Documents\x3C/a>\n```\n\nSo the document tab has its own URL: `/portal/ocgov/projects/210644/document`\n\nLet me think about the most efficient approach:\n\n**Option 1: Navigate to `/document` URL for each project**\n- Pro: File data is embedded in the initial HTML\n- Con: Need 1,322 page loads, each taking 2-5 seconds (~1-2 hours total)\n\n**Option 2: Navigate to main project page, click Downloads tab, then extract**\n- Pro: Same as above\n- Con: Same, but with extra click step\n\nActually, both approaches take the same time. Or use a persistent Chrome profile that already has the Cloudflare cookie\n\nLet me check how the original listing scraper handled this.\n\nActually, the `rip_all_safe.py` worked because the listing pages DO load (the React app loads, fiber is accessible). The detail pages might need more wait time or the user data dir needs to have the Cloudflare cookies.\n\nLet me update the test to wait longer and check if the Cloudflare challenge resolves.",time:$R[4726]={start:1782978223264,end:1782978226740},id:"prt_f21c89ca0001NcpD5EXEX1nWbx",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f21c88c3a001fxTfIvBNfM8qWp"},$R[4727]={type:"tool",tool:"write",callID:"call_00_mKrXK5PxGeeoM3pr3k5l7330",state:$R[4728]={status:"completed",input:$R[4729]={content:"\"\"\"Test detail page with longer wait and Cloudflare bypass\"\"\"\nimport undetected_chromedriver as uc\nimport time, json, re, tempfile\n\ntmpdir = tempfile.mkdtemp()\noptions = uc.ChromeOptions()\noptions.add_argument(\"--no-sandbox\")\noptions.add_argument(\"--window-size=1920,1080\")\noptions.add_argument(f\"--user-data-dir={tmpdir}\")\n\nprint(\"Starting Chrome...\")\ndriver = uc.Chrome(options=options, version_main=149)\n\ntry:\n    url = \"https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/210644\"\n    print(f\"Loading: {url}\")\n    driver.get(url)\n    \n    # Wait for Cloudflare to resolve (up to 30s)\n    for i in range(30):\n        title = driver.title\n        if \"Just a moment\" not in title:\n            print(f\"  Cloudflare bypassed after {i+1}s. Title: {title}\")\n            break\n        time.sleep(1)\n    else:\n        print(f\"  Cloudflare still blocking after 30s. Title: {title}\")\n    \n    # Wait more for React to render\n    time.sleep(5)\n    \n    print(f\"  URL: {driver.current_url}\")\n    print(f\"  Title: {driver.title}\")\n    \n    html = driver.page_source\n    print(f\"  HTML length: {len(html)}\")\n    \n    # Search for tabs\n    has_tabs = 'role=\"tab\"' in html\n    print(f\"  Has tabs: {has_tabs}\")\n    \n    # Search for Project Documents\n    has_docs = \"Project Documents\" in html\n    print(f\"  Has 'Project Documents': {has_docs}\")\n    \n    # Search for S3\n    s3_count = html.count(\"government-project.s3\")\n    print(f\"  S3 URL count: {s3_count}\")\n    \n    # Try to click Downloads tab if visible\n    try:\n        from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By\n        tabs = driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR, \"[role='tab']\")\n        print(f\"  Tab elements: {len(tabs)}\")\n        for t in tabs:\n            print(f\"    Tab: '{t.text.strip()}'\")\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"  Tab error: {e}\")\n    \n    # Save HTML for later analysis\n    with open(r\"C:\\Users\\HP\\OneDrive\\Documents\\opencode_work\\procurement_screenshots\\detail_test.html\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n        f.write(html)\n    print(\"  HTML saved to detail_test.html\")\n\nfinally:\n    driver.quit()\n",filePath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\test_detail_v3.py"},output:"Wrote file successfully.",metadata:$R[4730]={diagnostics:$R[4731]={},filepath:"C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\test_detail_v3.py",exists:!1,truncated:!1},title:"..\\..\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\test_detail_v3.py",time:$R[4732]={start:1782978230985,end:1782978231034}},id:"prt_f21c8aa39001C1qJrn9SYNSkxZ",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f21c88c3a001fxTfIvBNfM8qWp"},$R[4733]={reason:"tool-calls",snapshot:"",type:"step-finish",tokens:$R[4734]={total:81862,input:1156,output:656,reasoning:306,cache:$R[4735]={write:0,read:79744}},cost:0,id:"prt_f21c8be7e001ey6V3Jbew40aWp",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f21c88c3a001fxTfIvBNfM8qWp"}],msg_f21c8bf69001uo9hkIMg135OJP:$R[4736]=[$R[4737]={snapshot:"",type:"step-start",id:"prt_f21c8d832001dsEn3nuw4YLtwA",sessionID:"ses_10daf1e3dffegqE4Ex01XGpJRB",messageID:"msg_f21c8bf69001uo9hkIMg135OJP"},$R[4738]={type:"tool",tool:"bash",callID:"call_00_ET_x4zFE7lg7ru5uXLmZMty6328",state:$R[4739]={status:"completed",input:$R[4740]={command:"python3 \"C:\\Users\\HP\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\opencode\\test_detail_v3.py\" 2>&1",timeout:120000},output:"Starting Chrome...\r\nLoading: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/ocgov/projects/210644\r\n  Cloudflare bypassed after 12s. 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;\\\"\\u003EOC HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (OCHCD) \r\nannounces the release of the 2026 Supportive Housing Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) making available up to \r\n$20.9 million dollars of Federal HOME Investment Partnership Program (HOME), HOME American Rescue Plan Program \r\n(HOME-ARP), Mental Health Services Act (MHSA)\\u002FBehavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), 15G Reserves and Housing \r\nSuccessor Agency (HSA) Funds, to promote the acquisition, new construction, and acquisition\\u002Frehabilitation of \r\nSupportive Housing and will also provide up to 100 Housing Choice, Mainstream and\\u002For Veterans Affairs Supportive \r\nHousing Project Based Vouchers for extremely low-income households who are homeless.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp \r\nstyle=\\\"margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;\\\"\\u003EFunds are available until the NOFA closes, is \r\nreplaced by a new NOFA, or until all available funds are committed via Board of Supervisors action, whichever occurs \r\nfirst. Interested and qualified applicants who can successfully demonstrate their ability to provide supportive \r\nhousing for extremely low-income households who are experiencing homelessness are encouraged to submit \r\nproposals.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp style=\\\"margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: \r\n11pt;\\\"\\u003ESmall-scale housing is an eligible activity under this NOFA, so long as it meets NOFA criteria and the \r\nguiding principles in the Commission to Address Homelessness Small-Scale Housing Unit Report received and filed by the \r\nBoard of Supervisors on January 28, 2025.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp style=\\\"margin: 0in; \r\n11pt;\\\"\\u003E\\u003Cstrong\\u003E\\u003Cspan style=\\\"font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%;\\\"\\u003E2026 Supportive Housing \r\nNotice of Funding Availability \\u003C\\u002Fspan\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fstrong\\u003E\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp \r\nstyle=\\\"margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;\\\"\\u003EOC HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (OCHCD) \r\nannounces the release of the 2026 Supportive Housing Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) making available up to \r\n$20.9 million dollars of Federal HOME Investment Partnership Program (HOME), HOME American Rescue Plan Program \r\n(HOME-ARP), Mental Health Services Act (MHSA)\\u002FBehavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), 15G Reserves and Housing \r\nSuccessor Agency (HSA) Funds, to promote the acquisition, new construction, and acquisition\\u002Frehabilitation of \r\nSupportive Housing and will also provide up to 100 Housing Choice, Mainstream and\\u002For Veterans Affairs Supportive \r\nHousing Project Based Vouchers for extremely low-income households who are homeless.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp \r\nstyle=\\\"margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;\\\"\\u003EFunds are available until the NOFA closes, is \r\nreplaced by a new NOFA, or until all available funds are committed via Board of Supervisors action, whichever occurs \r\nfirst. Interested and qualified applicants who can successfully demonstrate their ability to provide supportive \r\nhousing for extremely low-income households who are experiencing homelessness are encouraged to submit \r\nproposals.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp style=\\\"margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: \r\n11pt;\\\"\\u003ESmall-scale housing is an eligible activity under this NOFA, so long as it meets NOFA criteria and the \r\nguiding principles in the Commission to Address Homelessness Small-Scale Housing Unit Report received and filed by the \r\nBoard of Supervisors on January 28, 2025.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp style=\\\"margin: 0in; 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;\\\"\\u003EOC HOUSING AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT (OCHCD) \r\nannounces the release of the 2026 Supportive Housing Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) making available up to \r\n$20.9 million dollars of Federal HOME Investment Partnership Program (HOME), HOME American Rescue Plan Program \r\n(HOME-ARP), Mental Health Services Act (MHSA)\\u002FBehavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), 15G Reserves and Housing \r\nSuccessor Agency (HSA) Funds, to promote the acquisition, new construction, and acquisition\\u002Frehabilitation of \r\nSupportive Housing and will also provide up to 100 Housing Choice, Mainstream and\\u002For Veterans Affairs Supportive \r\nHousing Project Based Vouchers for extremely low-income households who are homeless.\\u003C\\u002Fp\\u003E\\u003Cp \r\nstyle=\\\"margin: 0in 0in 8pt; line-height: 107%; font-size: 11pt;\\\"\\u003EFunds are available until the NOFA closes, is \r\nreplaced by a new NOFA, or until all available funds are committed via Board of Supervisors action, whichever occurs \r\nfirst.
